download_hf_tokenizers: download tokenizer models from Huggingface repositories for specified list of LLM models
update_get_vocab_base_pre: update convert_hf_to_gguf.py with generated get_vocab_base_pre function containing pre-tokenizer hashes
generate_tokenizer_tests: generate vocab test input and output files for each tokenizer model using standard test strings
compute_tokenizer_hash: compute sha256 hash of tokenizer encoding for a model to identify its BPE pre-tokenizer uniquely
check_missing_hashes: check which models are missing pre-tokenizer hashes in convert_hf_to_gguf.py without downloading
